title: Does CCS robustness to misleading prompts survive adversarial confounds? Following up the consistency claim

original_idea.body:
# CCS Adversarial Confounds

Construct consistent-but-false adversarial signals; measure how often CCS tracks the planted falsehood.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: whether consistency-based ELK can be adversarially gamed directly informs whether such methods are safe.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CCS plus adversarial QA construction on open model; clear inherited methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, public data, ELK red-teaming valuable.

low_compute.reasoning: CCS on small model, one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: CCS consistency-gaming is conceptually noted; a concrete adversarial study may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Consistency limits are known; the explicit adversarial attack study may be open.
